put.summary: C2 · Save the hourly labor/overhead rate of a work center
put.description: Body {expectedVersion, laborRate, overheadRate, reason (5-2000), currency=VND}. Writes version n+1; never changes a released work order's baseline. Idempotency-Key required. Needs PERM_COST_RATE_MANAGE.

get.summary: List item warehouse settings

put.summary: Create or update item warehouse setting
Save a routing draft and its whole operation graph atomically
put.description: Without routingId: a new DRAFT version of itemId (409 OPEN_DRAFT_EXISTS when the product already has one). With routingId + expectedVersion: full replacement of that DRAFT. Operations reference each other by clientKey; a predecessor must have a smaller sequence.

get.summary: Get an item's standard cost

put.summary: Create or update an item's standard cost
Save a BOM draft atomically — header and every line in one transaction
put.description: Without bomId: a new DRAFT version of parentItemId. With bomId + expectedVersion: full replacement of that DRAFT. Lines carry componentQuantity for outputQuantity; the server stores quantityPer = componentQuantity / outputQuantity.

get.summary: List WIP transactions

post.summary: Record WIP scrap or rework transaction
Preview the schedule release would commit
post.description: G8a: read-only — the same scheduling formula release uses, against the calendars as they are now, with overlap warnings against other work orders' committed load. Every body field is optional. Only for DRAFT, PLANNED and BLOCKED work orders.

post.summary: Reserve all short components automatically (FEFO)
post.description: Allocates available stock earliest expiry first — from the component line's own warehouse when it has one (G8a), otherwise across the plant's warehouses. Components with no stock left are simply skipped — check GET /material-readiness afterwards. Body {expectedWorkOrderVersion} is required (G8).

post.summary: Release work order
post.description: Fails with 409 STATE_CONFLICT when material reservation does not fully cover the component requirements; the work order is then persisted as BLOCKED. Use GET /material-readiness to see the shortage per component. Body {expectedWorkOrderVersion} is required (G8).

post.summary: Release every unissued reservation of the work order
post.description: G8a: gives the unissued part of each ACTIVE reservation back to free stock. No stock movement — on hand never changed. Body {expectedWorkOrderVersion} is required.

get.summary: List production receipt documents

post.summary: Create production receipt document
post.description: Creates a DRAFT receipt. No stock movement is created and the work order completed quantity is unchanged until the receipt is approved. G9a: expectedWorkOrderVersion and receivedOn are required; the destination must be the work order's output warehouse; the quantity may not exceed min(planned, final good) − approved − open claims.

post.summary: Withdraw a pending production receipt back to draft
post.description: G9a. Requester only, reason 5–2000 characters. The claimed output stays claimed.

post.summary: Submit draft production receipt for approval
post.description: Moves a DRAFT receipt to PENDING_APPROVAL. Still no inventory impact. G9a: requester only, body {expectedVersion, expectedWorkOrderVersion}.

post.summary: Reject pending production receipt
post.description: Closes the receipt without any inventory impact. G9a: both versions and a reason of 5–2000 characters.

post.summary: Record QC disposition for an approved production receipt
post.description: For lot-tracked output, changes the output lot from HOLD to AVAILABLE or REJECTED. For NON_TRACKED output, AVAILABLE releases qualityHoldQuantity while REJECTED leaves it held. On-hand quantity is unchanged either way.

get.summary: QC decisions of one production receipt
get.description: G9c. Newest first, immutable.

post.summary: Record one QC decision on part of an approved production receipt
post.description: G9c. accepted + rejected ≤ what is pending; a rejection needs a reason (5–2000). Tracked output splits child lots <lot>-A<n> (AVAILABLE) / <lot>-R<n> (REJECTED), the rest stays on the HOLD lot; non-tracked output releases the accepted part from quality hold. On-hand is unchanged.

post.summary: Cancel a draft or pending production receipt
post.description: G9a. Requester only, reason 5–2000 characters. Terminal; the claimed output is free again.

post.summary: Approve pending production receipt
post.description: Creates the RECEIVE stock movements and advances the work order. Newly created output lots start in HOLD status. G9a: body {expectedVersion, expectedWorkOrderVersion}; source, quota, lot number and dates are checked again.

get.summary: List shop floor production reports

post.summary: Report shop floor production
post.description: Records good/scrap/rework quantities. This — not the production receipt — is what advances and completes the work order. G8c: expectedWorkOrderVersion is required; on a work order with operations, workOrderOperationId is required, fresh work draws on the operation's confirmed input and a retry (sourceExecutionId) on its source's pending rework, only the last operation's good is final good, and consumption[] draws on the work order's own posted issue lines. Over a cap ⇒ 409 PLANNED_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED.

post.summary: Schedule draft work order
post.description: Moves DRAFT to PLANNED. Nothing is reserved and no material moves — this only records that a planner has committed to the dates. Body {expectedWorkOrderVersion, componentWarehouses?} — the version is required (G8).

post.summary: Submit work order output for approval
post.description: Creates a PENDING_APPROVAL production receipt. The work order is not completed and no stock is created until the receipt is approved.

post.summary: Manually adjust a work order operation's planned start/end
post.description: Never auto-shifts sibling operations. Overlapping the previous or next operation is 409 OPERATION_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT (G5); calendar/capacity problems stay advisory flags. plannedEndAt may be omitted — the server computes it over the work center's calendar.

post.summary: Confirm input of an operation
post.description: G8c: the first operation takes input from the plan once material was issued (409 MATERIAL_ISSUE_REQUIRED); a later one takes a transfer of its finished predecessor's good (409 OPERATION_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT otherwise). Over the cap ⇒ 409 PLANNED_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED.

post.summary: Finish an operation
post.description: G8c: allowed once its input and pending rework are used up and every good unit of the predecessor was transferred in (409 STATE_CONFLICT otherwise).

post.summary: Return unused issued material to its source
post.description: Body {expectedWorkOrderVersion, reason (5-2000), lines[1..500] {sourceIssueLineId, quantity}}. Each line goes back to the warehouse and lot of its issue line. Cap per issue line: issued - consumed - returned. Idempotency-Key required. Needs PERM_MATERIAL_RETURN_MANAGE.

post.summary: Reserve material for work order

get.summary: List material issue documents

post.summary: Post material issue document
Reject an Over-BOM material request without stock impact
post.description: G8b: body {expectedWorkOrderVersion, expectedIssueVersion, reason} — reason 5–2000 characters.

post.summary: Withdraw your own pending material request
post.description: G8b: only the requester; PENDING_APPROVAL → CANCELLED, no stock effect. Body {expectedWorkOrderVersion, expectedIssueVersion, reason} — reason 5–2000 characters.

post.summary: Approve an Over-BOM material request and atomically post stock
post.description: G8b: body {expectedWorkOrderVersion, expectedIssueVersion, reason?} — both versions required. Approving your own request also needs PERM_MATERIAL_ISSUE_OVERRIDE.

post.summary: C10 · Finalize the production cost and close the work order (atomic)
post.description: Body {expectedVersion, expectedSourceVersion, runId, expectedRunVersion, reason (5-2000)}. Re-calculates on the server, checks the 11 conditions, writes the final snapshot and value-only entries and CLOSED in one transaction. Idempotency-Key required. Needs PERM_WORK_ORDER_CLOSE and cost view.

get.summary: C8 · Cost runs of a work order
get.description: Newest first.

post.summary: C7 · Calculate and save a production cost preview
post.description: Body {expectedVersion, expectedSourceVersion}. No stock, value or work order change. Idempotency-Key required. Needs PERM_PRODUCTION_COST_CALCULATE.

post.summary: Issue work order component
post.description: Convenience endpoint for a single component line. It does NOT support over-issue override: issuing beyond the remaining BOM requirement fails here. Use POST /api/v1/work-orders/{workOrderId}/material-issues with an overrideReason instead.

post.summary: Complete production of a work order
post.description: G8c: for completing below the plan — reaching the plan completes it on its own. Every operation must be finished and no issue pending. A shortfall needs a 5–2000 character reason and PERM_MATERIAL_ISSUE_APPROVE. Nothing is received, closed or posted to stock.

post.summary: Close work order
post.description: Reconciles and permanently locks a COMPLETED work order — releases any leftover ACTIVE reservation back to available stock, then locks it against every further write (reserve, issue, receipt, adjust). Only allowed from COMPLETED; anything else returns 409 STATE_CONFLICT.

post.summary: Cancel work order
post.description: Spec §3.2 requires a reason; omitting it returns 400 APPROVAL_REASON_REQUIRED. expectedWorkOrderVersion is required too (G8). Gives the planning quota back once.

post.summary: Run MRP synchronously
post.description:
Optional Idempotency-Key: replaying the same key with the same body returns the
run created the first time instead of computing a second one over the same
demand. Replaying it with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Sending
no key keeps the previous behaviour — every call starts a new run.

A run that ended FAILED still owns its key; retry it with a new key.

get.summary: List conversions of a planning run

post.summary: Convert proposals of a commercial run into draft documents
post.description:
All entries MAKE (one DRAFT work order each) or all BUY (one DRAFT purchase
order, supplierId required, one receiving warehouse). Partial and repeatable:
each quantity must not exceed the requirement's remaining convertible quantity.
expectedConversionVersion / expectedSourceVersion come from the run; a stale
one is 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION / PLANNING_SOURCE_STALE. No approve step.
Optional Idempotency-Key: a replay returns the same documents.

post.summary: Run MRP over sales order lines (commercial run)
post.description:
Plans the uncovered quantity of the selected sales order lines (ordered minus QC
accepted, held stock and open work order coverage). salesOrderLineIds are sales
order line ids, not planning demand ids. Period at most 90 days, both ends
included. itemWarehouseMappings choose the netting warehouse of an item for this
run only; outputWarehouseId, when sent, must equal demandWarehouseId.
includeRop=true is refused (422): no reorder quantity is configured anywhere.
Optional Idempotency-Key, same contract as POST /v1/planning-runs.

get.summary: List material issue documents across a plant
get.description: Spec §4.1. Flat form of GET /work-orders/{workOrderId}/material-issues; pass workOrderId to narrow it to one work order. status=PENDING_APPROVAL is the plant-wide Over-BOM approval queue. Default sort is requestedAt, which every document carries; postedAt is null until approval, so sorting the queue by it orders nothing.

get.summary: Get work order variance — material, output, WIP, and time
get.description: Returns materialLines (planned vs issued per component, OVER_ISSUED / UNDER_ISSUED), outputVariance (planned vs actual output), wipSummary (scrap, rework) — invariant B20 — and timeVariance (plannedMinutes/actualMinutes/varianceMinutes, invariant B86). plannedMinutes sums setupMinutes + runMinutesPerUnit x plannedQuantity across the routing snapshot; actualMinutes sums the duration of every production execution that has ended, excluding ones still in progress. costVariance is retained for compatibility but authoritative=false while detailed costing is deferred.

get.summary: Where the output of one production receipt came from

Receipts written before the contribution ledger report outputEvidenceKnown = false.

List low-stock and reorder alerts
get.description:
Every item-warehouse line in the scope that has an ACTIVE setting, optionally
filtered by status. Deliberately not paginated: it returns one row per configured
threshold. Same alert-line shape and ordering as the dashboard's topLowStockLines,
but without the OK lines being dropped.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: OK | LOW_STOCK | REORDER_NEEDED. Absent returns all three.

get.summary: Get inventory dashboard
get.description:
One aggregate read for the dashboard: threshold counts, a shortage summary, the
worst alert lines and the newest ledger rows, all resolved to display labels so no
follow-up call to Item, Warehouse or User is needed.

Counts are per item-warehouse line, since safety stock and reorder point are
configured per warehouse. Requires PERM_INVENTORY_READ on the requested scope;
a scope outside the caller's assignments is 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, an unknown
scope id is 404 ENTITY_NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: scopeType
parameters.description: COMPANY aggregates every plant/warehouse of the company, PLANT every warehouse of the plant, WAREHOUSE exactly one warehouse

parameters.name: scopeId
parameters.description: Id of the company, plant or warehouse named by scopeType

parameters.name: lowStockLimit
parameters.description: Alert lines to return (1-20, default 10). Out-of-range values are clamped, not rejected.

parameters.name: movementLimit
parameters.description: Ledger rows to return (1-20, default 10). Out-of-range values are clamped, not rejected.

List production receipt documents across a plant
get.description: Spec §6.2. Flat form of GET /work-orders/{workOrderId}/production-receipts. G9a filters: workOrderId, destinationWarehouseId, receivedFrom/receivedTo (plant-local dates, inclusive) and search (receipt code, work order code, item SKU/name, lot number). QC-only permissions read APPROVED receipts only. G9c: qualityState, pendingQc, hasQcDecision.

get.summary: List work orders with finished output still to be warehoused
get.description: Spec §6.2. Returns RELEASED, IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED work orders whose receiptable good — min(planned, final good), G9a D12 — has not yet been fully receipted, already net of receipts still in DRAFT or PENDING_APPROVAL (invariant B76). COMPLETED is included on purpose: the shop floor being done does not mean the goods reached the racks. Optional workOrderId and free-text search (work order code, item SKU/name).

safetyStock.description: Configured safety stock for this item in this warehouse

reorderPoint.description: Configured reorder point for this item in this warehouse

status.description: OK | LOW_STOCK | REORDER_NEEDED. Mutually exclusive; REORDER_NEEDED outranks LOW_STOCK.

uomCode.description: Display unit of the item (items.unit — free text, not yet an FK to the UOM master)

onHandQuantity.description: Eligible on-hand: stock physically in the warehouse, excluding lots that are not AVAILABLE

reservedQuantity.description: Part of the eligible on-hand already reserved for work orders

qualityHoldQuantity.description: Part of the eligible on-hand held for QC on non-lot-tracked production output (B2). Usually zero.

shortageQuantity.description: max(0, max(safetyStock, reorderPoint) − availableQuantity): how much must be replenished to clear the alert. Always 0 when status is OK.

movementType.description: RECEIVE | ISSUE | ADJUST_IN | ADJUST_OUT | REVERSAL | LOT_STATUS_CHANGE

direction.description: IN | OUT | NONE. NONE is used by LOT_STATUS_CHANGE, which moves no stock.

lotId.description: Null for items that are not lot-tracked

lotCode.description: Null for items that are not lot-tracked

referenceType.description: Free-text classifier written by the posting service (WORK_ORDER, GOODS_RECEIPT, …); null for a movement posted directly through the inventory API without one

referenceId.description: Id of the source document, paired with referenceType. Not a business document number.

actorUserId.description: Who posted the movement (stock_movements.created_by); null for rows written outside a user request

actorUsername.description: Username of actorUserId, resolved in one batch query; null when the actor is unknown or the user record no longer exists

DashboardRecentMovementResponse.description: Newest ledger rows in the scope, capped by movementLimit

scopeType.description: COMPANY | PLANT | WAREHOUSE — echoed back from the request

companyId.description: Company owning the scope, resolved server-side

totalItemCount.description: Number of distinct items that have an ACTIVE item-warehouse setting inside the scope — not the item master count

totalWarehouseCount.description: Warehouses inside the scope. Includes INACTIVE warehouses, because stock in a deactivated warehouse is still physically there.

okCount.description: Item-warehouse lines at OK. The three counts are mutually exclusive and sum to the number of ACTIVE settings in scope.

topLowStockLines.description: Worst alert lines first (REORDER_NEEDED, then largest shortage), capped by lowStockLimit. OK lines are never included.

recentMovements.description: Newest ledger rows in the scope, capped by movementLimit

generatedAt.description: When the server computed this snapshot (ISO-8601 UTC). Nothing here is cached — every figure is read live.
